reasons.correctness: Column, entity field and DTO field are added. The paged mapper sets displayOrder; toDto gets it via ModelMapper name matching. Hidden tests pass 4/4. Weak spot: the seed sets PLN=0 but leaves other currencies at default 0, so they tie with PLN.
reasons.convention_fit: The changeset is in 2026/09 with a DD-MM-YYYY kebab name, changeset header and rollback. It is included last in changelog.xml under a month comment. No existing changeset edited. A new MockitoExtension unit test is added.
reasons.design_fit: Minimal footprint: one field each on Currency and CurrencyDtoOut, one setter line in the existing paged mapper, and reuse of ModelMapper for toDto. No new mechanisms, no layering changes.
reasons.test_quality: CurrencyServiceDisplayOrderUnitTest only uses displayOrder 0, which is the int default, so it passes even without the mapping. The toDto test stubs modelMapper to return the expected DTO, so it is tautological. Strictness is LENIENT.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the currency files; the agent then read them directly. Changelog placement, test fixtures and constructor usage were found with grep, find and ls, not the graph.
